cases.input: An FDA recall has a DRC-requested three-week reporting cadence, a current authorized strategy, reconciled consignee/action/product evidence, completed effectiveness checks and no material new safety facts. Prepare the next status report and assess termination-request readiness.
requiredBehaviors: use the recall-specific FDA reporting cadence instead of replacing it with a generic interval
build a versioned status snapshot covering notification responses nonresponses product accounting effectiveness checks and completion estimate
prepare termination-request readiness from current status effectiveness and disposition evidence without claiming FDA termination
forbiddenBehaviors: replace the FDA-specified cadence with an automatic two-week or four-week schedule
recompute field-action effectiveness as a second independent assessment
label the recall FDA-terminated because internal execution is complete
skillAnchors: FDA cadence is an external case state
Status report is a snapshot, not history rewrite

cases.input: The firm considers the recall operationally complete, but a small set of nonresponding consignees and not-located devices remains. Management wants them removed from the final status report before requesting termination.
requiredBehaviors: keep nonresponding consignees and not-located devices visible in the current status and termination-readiness evidence
evaluate whether the residual unknowns are supportable under the current recall strategy without silently redefining the denominator
keep firm-completed and FDA-terminated as separate authority states
forbiddenBehaviors: delete unresolved consignees or devices from the status report to improve completion
treat an internal completion decision as an FDA termination decision
invent FDA acceptance of residual unknowns

cases.input: A termination request package is ready when the same serious event occurs after correction and the firm extends the action to another lot. Operations asks to submit the old package unchanged and mention the new lot in the next status report.
requiredBehaviors: interrupt termination readiness and preserve the prior request package as historical
route the new serious event to MDR recall risk and CAPA reassessment without waiting for the next status report
route the lot extension to fda-corrections-removals for possible Part 806 amendment assessment
forbiddenBehaviors: submit the superseded termination package unchanged after material new safety evidence
hide the scope extension only inside a later recall status report
allow prior high effectiveness to override the new serious event

cases.input: After a termination request is submitted, FDA asks for additional disposition evidence and changes the expected reporting cadence. The firm wants to overwrite the prior request and mark the recall terminated once the requested files are uploaded.
requiredBehaviors: record the FDA request and changed cadence as new append-only authority events
create a new controlled response or request-package version while preserving the submitted historical package
keep FDA-review-pending or more-information-required until verified FDA termination evidence exists
forbiddenBehaviors: overwrite the historical submitted request package
infer FDA termination from uploading requested evidence
retain the superseded reporting cadence after FDA changed it
skillAnchors: Agency questions reopen the package, not history
